title: Bridge log summarizer

parent.objective: Bring up a host-side bridge for the fictional SYNTH-SENSOR-1 so that every component is verified independently and no hardware behavior is claimed before it is observed.

goal: Summarize bridge log lines into kind counts and the reading range without raising on malformed lines.
non_goals: Read from a device or a transport.

prohibited: Import codec, transport, device or adapter.

inputs.name: Log line format
inputs.description: KIND [rest]; READING lines carry an integer.

assumptions: Log lines are host-generated text; no hardware assumption applies.

sources.reference: examples/software-hardware/sample — the synthetic bridge package and its tests
sources.authority: Reference implementation for this example only; establishes no real device behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Kinds are counted and the reading range is tracked.
A malformed reading is counted, never raised.

architecture_boundaries: Telemetry stays a pure function of text.
